heroSummary: The Creality K1 Max is natively equipped with an enclosure and high-temperature hotend, allowing eSUN ABS+ to run reliably up to 214 mm/s at an 18 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. Keeping the chamber fully sealed and preheated ensures excellent inter-layer bonding and minimal warp without requiring hardware upgrades.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with a thin layer of PVA glue stick or Dimafix as an adhesive and release interface.
slicerTweaks: Cap Maximum Volumetric Speed at 18 mm³/s in the filament profile to prevent extrusion starvation at high feedrates.
Set Chamber Exhaust Fan and Side Auxiliary Fan to 0% to prevent thermal shock and severe part warping.
Configure Part Cooling Fan threshold to keep the fan at 0% for the first 4 layers, ramping to a 10-25% range only on overhangs and short layer times under 15 seconds.
Enable a 5mm outer brim with 0mm offset in OrcaSlicer to reinforce footprint contact on wide-geometry parts.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting and print edge warping
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Chamber temperature too low or draft ingress causing differential thermal shrinkage in the ABS+ matrix.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Preheat the bed to 98°C for 15-20 minutes with the door and lid closed to soak the chamber to >45°C before initiating the print, and apply glue stick to the PEI bed.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Delamination / layer separation under structural load
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive part cooling fan speed or hotend temperature below the optimal melting range for high-speed extrusion.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Increase nozzle temperature to 255°C, reduce maximum part cooling fan to 15%, and disable the auxiliary side fan completely.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and rough surface texture during infill
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Exceeding the 18 mm³/s maximum volumetric flow rate during high-velocity infill passes.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enforce the 18 mm³/s Max Volumetric Speed limit in OrcaSlicer and drop infill print speed from stock 300+ mm/s down to 210 mm/s.

faq.question: Do I need to leave the Creality K1 Max top glass lid off when printing eSUN ABS+?
faq.answer: No, keep the top lid on and front door shut. ABS+ requires a warm, draft-free chamber around 40-50°C to prevent warping and inter-layer separation.

faq.question: Can the K1 Max reach the recommended bed temperature for eSUN ABS+?
faq.answer: Yes, eSUN ABS+ prints well at 95-100°C, which is within the 100°C maximum limit of the K1 Max heated bed. Set the bed to 98°C for optimal adhesion.

faq.question: Does eSUN ABS+ need to be dried before printing on the K1 Max?
faq.answer: Yes, ABS+ is hygroscopic. Dry the filament in a dedicated dryer at 65-70°C for at least 4-6 hours to prevent stringing, popping, and surface defects.

faq.question: Why is the stock side auxiliary fan disabled for this profile?
faq.answer: The side auxiliary fan blows massive volumes of unheated air across the build plate, which causes immediate uneven cooling, layer splitting, and bed detachment in ABS+.
